description: Ground-truth manifest for the failroute benchmark corpus. Each entry is an independently labelled true positive: (file, line of the `except` keyword, expected mode). Absence of a finding on any other handler in the corpus files is a labelled true negative. Labels were derived from the semantics of each fixture, not from tool output.

labelled_true_negatives.note: re-raise wrapped as domain error: still propagation
return value derived from the exception, not a constant
documented limitation: handlers that log are informational
fallback return unreachable after unconditional raise
non-empty container is not a fallback shape
failroute: ignore marker - reviewed and accepted
pragma: no cover marker - explicitly defensive
